_comment: Live-search PROBE SET 4 (post-test Phase 7): FRESH claims for validating the entity-grounding gate on the English route (a Wikipedia page is judged only if its title is about the claim's subject). Drafted from the failure types of set 3 (a related page about another entity; a generic-word private claim matched to an unrelated page) but with entities disjoint from sets 1-3. Includes near-named rivers (Godavari, Narmada), spelling-variant subjects, a 'first Indian to ...' trap, and private local claims that use ordinary nouns (bus, shop, market). Same scoring and adoption rule as sets 1-3 (scripts/live_probe.py). Our own wording; a demo set, not a benchmark. label: true | false | unverifiable. Labels APPROVED by the project owner on 2026-10-04: all 38 checked, none changed; one 'why' made more explicit (en-t5). The set is 16 true / 17 false / 5 unverifiable (the owner's review message counted 15 / 18; the claims and labels are what they approved).
